end.summary:
Reyansh practised top, front, and side views of glasses, cones, cylinders, and cubes.
They correctly identified several views, including a glass and cone side view.
They matched views to objects in all 3 attempts.
They did not yet explain why views change by observer position; the same-view mix-up remained in the final turns.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing solids from the top, front, and side, using examples such as a glass, cone, cylinder, and cube. They used the outside shape to explain why hidden inner lines are not shown, and they matched each view to its object in the matching activity. They mixed up the idea that another person sees the same view from a different place, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, place a cup or box on a table and ask Reyansh what it looks like from two different positions, then compare the answers.
